"Thames Water Seeks Bill Hike Just as Burnham Promises Change." Thames Water has applied to regulator Ofwat to raise household charges again, presenting a dilemma to new Prime Minister Andy Burnham, who has vowed to ease the UK's cost-of-living crisis and overhaul the beleaguered water sector. Thames Water is Britain's largest water and wastewater company, serving around 16 million customers, and has been struggling under a heavy debt burden.
